# TransUnion to Add Nova Credit Cash Flow Intelligence to Resident Screening, Helping Operators Approve More Qualified Renters


## Planned integration of Nova Credit’s Cash Atlas® into TruVision™ Resident Screening will help operators approve more qualified renters from the applicants already in their pipeline


TransUnion (NYSE: TRU) announced today that its TruVision Resident Screening solution will provide cash flow intelligence for rental applicants. Expected in 2027, the product enhancement will increase consumers’ access to rental housing and help property managers discover a greater number of qualified applicants for their rental units.


“


> Nova Credit’s cash flow intelligence broadens the picture TransUnion can provide to property managers. The result is greater transparency for faster decisions with higher confidence, and more opportunities for deserving renters to access housing.


Maitri Johnson, SVP and head of TransUnion’s tenant and employment screening business


„


The planned collaboration will integrate Nova Credit’s Cash Atlas® into TransUnion’s


[Resident Screening solution](https://www.transunion.com/solution/truvision/tenant-risk/resident-screening?utm_campaign=Press+Release+Nova+Credit+and+Resident+Screening+Partnership&utm_keyword=&utm_medium=press-release&utm_source=press-release&utm_content=) . Once available, operators will be able to speed up approvals by evaluating an applicant’s current financial health alongside the traditional credit, criminal and eviction insights used today.


“Nova Credit’s cash flow intelligence broadens the picture TransUnion can provide to property managers,” said Maitri Johnson, SVP and head of TransUnion’s tenant and employment screening business. “The result is greater transparency for faster decisions with higher confidence, and more opportunities for deserving renters to access housing.”


TransUnion’s rental screening solutions help property managers mitigate risk and reduce costs by providing comprehensive, data-driven insights into a prospective tenant's background. The integration of Nova Credit’s cash flow platform will help property managers make decisions on applicants who fall below standard screening criteria.


The opportunity is significant. Nova Credit’s recent report,


[How Cash Flow Data Surfaces Qualified Renters](https://events.novacredit.com/how-cash-flow-data-surfaces-qualified-renters) , found that 26% to 37% of declined and conditionally approved applicants have the cash flow of a qualified renter and can be approved within an operator’s existing risk profile when leveraging Cash Atlas.


***The right data for better, faster decisions***
According to a TransUnion analysis of its rental screening data from January 2025 through June 2026, one in five applicants were declined, with roughly two-thirds of those declines driven by credit score. Another 11% were referred for further review because they had little or no credit history. Applicants who are only conditionally approved may often face larger deposits, guarantor requirements or manual reviews.


These steps add friction, slow the path to a signed lease, and put property managers at risk for losing qualified tenants. Nationally,


[about 44% of renters](http://federalreserve.gov/econres/notes/feds-notes/measuring-renters-in-credit-data-evidence-from-linked-survey-and-administrative-data-20260508.html) have credit scores below 660, so many qualified prospects may be discouraged from applying at all.


“Signing qualified, responsible renters is becoming an increasingly competitive business, so every lease matters,” said Johnson. “Combining credit and cash flow scores can create more opportunities for renters and property managers alike.”


Nova Credit’s Cash Atlas® analyzes multi-aggregator bank transaction data across income patterns, cash reserves and spending behavior to produce a predictive FCRA-compliant cash flow score. Through the planned integration, the score will be delivered directly within TruVision alongside Resident Score®, TransUnion’s proprietary model designed to help predict eviction risk. Operators can then move qualified applicants from decline to conditional approval, or from conditional to standard approval, without leaving their existing workflow or adding manual work.


“In this market, the fastest way to fill a unit is to approve the qualified renter who has already applied,” said Akaash Gupta, Head of Rental Housing at Nova Credit. “Too many of those applicants get stuck in a decline or a conditional approval because their credit file doesn’t tell the whole story. By bringing cash flow intelligence into TruVision, we’ll help property managers say yes sooner and with confidence.”
